title: Wrong email or password
meaning: Firebase rejected the email/password pair (or no such account).
userFix: Re-type both carefully, or use Forgot password. Students use the student sign-in; non-Babson emails use Guest access.
staffCheck: Confirm which sign-in they used. Check Firebase Console → Authentication → Users for the email.

title: Sign-in required
meaning: The request reached the server without a valid sign-in.
staffCheck: If they ARE signed in, have them sign out and in again; check the device clock.

title: Session expired
meaning: Their sign-in token was rejected as expired or invalid.
staffCheck: If it repeats for everyone, check FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON belongs to the same Firebase project as the app/site config (BR-SRV-002).

title: Recent sign-in needed
meaning: Deleting an account requires a sign-in from the last 5 minutes.
userFix: Enter your password when asked, then try deleting again right away.

title: Email not verified
meaning: The action needs a verified email address.
userFix: Open the verification email, click the link, then tap 'I've verified'. Check spam.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Users shows verified status. Resend from the app or website.

title: Too many attempts
meaning: Firebase temporarily blocked this device after repeated failures.
userFix: Wait about 15 minutes, or reset the password.

title: Sign-in failed (other reason)
meaning: Firebase returned an error we don't have a specific code for.
userFix: Try again; if it repeats, send us the code and what you were doing.
staffCheck: Check the browser console / Xcode log for the raw Firebase error code.

title: Email sign-in is turned off
meaning: Email/Password is not enabled in Firebase (auth/operation-not-allowed).
userFix: Nothing you can do; contact the station.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method → enable Email/Password.

title: This website address isn't authorized
meaning: The domain isn't in Firebase's authorized list (auth/unauthorized-domain).
userFix: Nothing you can do; contact the station.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains → add the domain (babsonradio.com, www., and any .vercel.app).

title: Account disabled
meaning: The account was disabled in Firebase.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Users → re-enable.

title: Signed in, profile did not load
meaning: The app signed in with Firebase but could not load the account from the server.
userFix: Close and reopen the app, then try again.
staffCheck: Check /api/health and the Vercel logs for /api/me. The app must send X-Preview-Key while the site is locked.

title: Firebase rejected the developer sign-in
meaning: The server accepted the password but Firebase would not sign the app in with the token.
staffCheck: The iOS GoogleService-Info.plist and the web/server Firebase project must be the same project (babson-radio). Check Authentication is enabled.

title: Babson email required
meaning: Student sign-up/sign-in needs a @babson.edu address (or a guest used a Babson address).
userFix: Use your @babson.edu email for student accounts; use Guest access with any other email.

title: Email already has an account
meaning: An account with this email already exists.
userFix: Sign in instead, or use Forgot password.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Users.

title: Phone number already registered
meaning: Another account already uses this phone number.
userFix: Sign in to the existing account. If it isn't yours, contact the station.
staffCheck: Look up the number's owner via the users collection (phoneNumber). Never share it with the requester.

title: Invalid phone number
meaning: Not a valid 10-digit US number.

title: Password problem
meaning: Password too short/long (8–128 characters) or too weak.

title: Name missing
meaning: First name is required.

title: Delete confirmation missing
meaning: The delete request didn't include the confirmation.
userFix: Use the Delete my account button and enter your password.

title: Profile not found
meaning: The sign-in exists but its profile record is missing.
userFix: Sign out and back in. If it repeats, contact the station.
staffCheck: Compare Authentication → Users with Firestore users/{uid}. A failed sign-up can leave Auth without a profile; delete the Auth user so they can re-register.

title: Invalid email address
meaning: The email isn't formatted correctly.

title: Sponsor not found
meaning: No verified Babson student with that email is registered.
userFix: Check the spelling; the student must have created and verified an account.
staffCheck: Look up users where email == sponsor email and check emailVerified in Authentication.

title: Sponsor is at the guest limit
meaning: A student can sponsor up to 10 guests at once.
userFix: Ask the student to revoke an old pass.
staffCheck: Limit is MAX_ACTIVE_GUESTS_PER_STUDENT in lib/guest.ts.

title: Too many guest requests today
meaning: Guests can send 5 sponsor requests per 24 hours.

title: End-of-semester not configured
meaning: No upcoming semester-end date.
staffCheck: SEMESTER_END_DATES in Vercel (MM-DD,MM-DD). Defaults to 12-18,05-14 if unset.

title: Guest access not needed
meaning: Students already have full access.
userFix: Sign in with your Babson account.

title: Guest trial or pass ended
meaning: Live access has run out.
userFix: Ask a Babson student to sponsor you.
staffCheck: Check guestTrials/{uid} and guestPasses/{uid}.

title: Contact sync limit reached
meaning: Contact matching is limited to 5 times per day.

title: Contact data problem
meaning: The contact list sent was empty or too large.
userFix: Update the app and try again.
staffCheck: Max 5000 hashes per sync.

title: Time not allowed
meaning: Air-time requests must start 24h–60 days ahead, 15–240 minutes long, on a 15-minute mark.
userFix: Pick a time that fits those rules.
staffCheck: Rules live in lib/slots.ts.

title: Time already booked
meaning: Another approved slot overlaps.
staffCheck: Check airSlots for the time range.

title: Too many pending requests
meaning: Limit of 3 pending requests per person.
userFix: Wait for a decision or cancel one.

title: Request can't be changed
meaning: It was already decided, cancelled or started.

title: Request details missing or invalid
meaning: Title, category, type or audio link is missing or invalid (audio links must be https and only for pre-recorded shows).

title: Verification or permission needed
meaning: The action requires a verified Babson account.

title: Staff only
meaning: The action is limited to staff or the owner.

title: Invalid request
meaning: The server couldn't use what was sent.
userFix: Check the form and try again; update the app if it repeats.

title: Not found or already handled
meaning: The item doesn't exist or was already dealt with.

title: Rate limit
meaning: Too many requests too quickly.

title: Unexpected server error
meaning: Something failed that we haven't classified.
userFix: Try again. If it repeats, send the code AND the 'ref' number.
staffCheck: Search Vercel → Logs for the ref value; the full error is printed next to it.

title: Server key missing
meaning: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON isn't set on the server.
staffCheck: Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables → add it, then redeploy. Check /api/health.

title: Server key malformed
meaning: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON isn't valid one-line JSON or the key is wrong.
staffCheck: Regenerate the key, convert to ONE line (json.dumps), paste with no extra quotes, redeploy.

title: Server secret missing
meaning: PHONE_HASH_PEPPER is missing or under 16 characters.
staffCheck: Set a random 32+ character value (openssl rand -hex 32) in Vercel and redeploy. Never change it later.

title: Database not created
meaning: Firestore has no database in this Firebase project.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Firestore Database → Create database.

title: Database index missing
meaning: A query needs a Firestore index.
staffCheck: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes (or open the link in the error log). Wait until the index shows Enabled.

title: Authentication not set up
meaning: Firebase Authentication isn't initialized for the project.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Get started → enable Email/Password.

title: Server not allowed to use the database
meaning: The service account lacks permission or belongs to a different project.
staffCheck: Regenerate the key from the SAME project (babson-radio); check IAM roles (Firebase Admin SDK / Editor).

title: Server couldn't reach Firebase
meaning: Network timeout or connection failure to Google services.
staffCheck: Check status.firebase.google.com; usually transient.

title: Can't reach Babson Radio
meaning: The device is offline or the server didn't answer.
userFix: Check your internet connection and try again.
staffCheck: Open https://babsonradio.com/api/health from the same device.

title: App not connected to server
meaning: The iOS app's server address isn't set.
staffCheck: BackendConfig.baseURLString must be the live site URL, no trailing slash.

title: Sign-in not set up in this app build
meaning: The iOS build is missing Firebase or GoogleService-Info.plist.
staffCheck: Add the Firebase package and a correctly named GoogleService-Info.plist to the BabsonRadio target; clean build.

title: Unreadable server reply
meaning: The server answered with something the app couldn't understand.
staffCheck: Compare app and website versions; check /api/health.

title: Playback couldn't start
meaning: The stream didn't load.
userFix: Check your connection and try again.
staffCheck: Open the stream URL directly; check the Asura panel (source connected? bitrate/listener limit?).

title: Site isn't open yet
meaning: The website is in pre-launch mode and this request didn't include the preview password.
userFix: Babson Radio opens on October 22. Check back then.
staffCheck: Unlock in a browser at /coming-soon (Developer access), or send the X-Preview-Key header. iOS: set BackendConfig.previewKey. To open the site for everyone, set PRELAUNCH_OFF=1 in Vercel and redeploy.

title: Invite-only until launch
meaning: Before launch, only emails on the beta tester list can create an account or open the site.
userFix: Ask the station to add your Babson email, then try again.
staffCheck: Add the email at /admin/testers (Admin → Beta Testers). Remove the restriction on launch day by setting PRELAUNCH_OFF=1.

title: Host controls are closed
meaning: Radio controls and the set list are open from 4 hours before a host's show until 4 hours after it.
userFix: Come back closer to your show time.
staffCheck: Check the show's day and times in Admin → Schedule, and the time zone in Auto-Scheduler. Developers and admins are never blocked.

title: Not a host of that show
meaning: The account is not listed as a host of that show.
userFix: Ask a station admin to add you as a host.
staffCheck: Admin → Schedule → edit the show → Host accounts (usernames). Approved student slots are linked to the student automatically.

title: Radio did not accept the command
meaning: The station software (AzuraCast) refused or did not answer the skip command.
staffCheck: Check AZURACAST_URL / AZURACAST_API_KEY in Vercel, and that the API key's role has Manage Station Broadcasting.

title: Last name missing
meaning: Sign-up needs both a first and last name.
staffCheck: Client validation or /api/auth/signup rejected an empty lastName.

title: Graduation year missing
meaning: Sign-up needs a graduation year (or Alumni / Faculty or staff).
userFix: Pick your graduation year from the list and try again.
staffCheck: None needed. The form blocks this before the server is called.

title: Terms not accepted
meaning: Creating an account requires agreeing to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
userFix: Tick the box that says you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, then try again.
staffCheck: None needed. Acceptance time and version are saved on the user's profile (termsAcceptedAt, termsVersion).
